newsReadings.title: A Quiet Hall in the Forbidden City
newsReadings.passage:
The Palace Museum in Beijing announced that Wuying Hall, one of the historic buildings in the Forbidden City, will close to visitors starting October 19, 2026. The museum did not say when the hall will open again.

Wuying Hall, which means "Hall of Military Prowess," was built hundreds of years ago during the Ming Dynasty. It is part of the Imperial Palaces of the Ming and Qing Dynasties, a site on UNESCO's World Heritage List since 1987.

The museum said the closure is for the protection of the old building, the care of its collections, and the improvement of its displays. Workers will repair the wooden structure and update the exhibition inside the hall.

Visitors can still visit other parts of the Forbidden City. The museum advises travelers to check the latest notices before their trip, as some halls may have different opening hours.

The Forbidden City was built between 1406 and 1420 and was home to 24 emperors. Today it is one of the most visited museums in the world, welcoming millions of visitors every year.

options: To protect the old building and improve its displays
To build a new shopping mall

questions.q: When was the Forbidden City built?
Can visitors still visit the Forbidden City?
options: No, the whole palace is closed

newsReadings.title: Typhoon Season: Staying Safe in Strong Winds
newsReadings.passage:
October is typhoon season in East Asia. This week, a strong typhoon is moving toward Taiwan, bringing heavy rain and powerful winds. Weather experts say people should prepare for the storm during the holiday.

A typhoon is a huge storm that forms over warm ocean water. When it reaches land, it can break trees, damage houses, and cause floods. In the past, strong typhoons have forced schools to close and flights to stop.

To stay safe, experts give some simple advice. First, keep enough food and drinking water at home for two or three days. Second, stay away from windows during the storm, and do not go outside when the wind is strong. Third, charge your phone and flashlight before the power goes out.

After the typhoon passes, be careful of fallen trees and broken electric wires on the road. Do not touch the wires; call the police or the power company instead.

Typhoons are a natural part of life in this region. With good preparation, people can stay safe and return to normal life quickly.

questions.q: What should people keep at home before a typhoon?
What should you NOT do during the storm?
options: Go outside when the wind is strong

questions.q: What should you do if you see broken electric wires?
options: Do not touch them; call the police or power company

newsReadings.title: AI Takes the Stage in Berlin
newsReadings.passage:
This week, the world's attention turns to Berlin, Germany, where chip company NVIDIA holds its GTC technology conference. Company leader Jensen Huang will give an important speech on October 21.

NVIDIA is famous for making the powerful chips that train artificial intelligence (AI). These chips help computers learn languages, recognize pictures, and even drive cars. In recent years, the need for AI chips has grown very fast around the world.

At the Berlin event, the company is expected to share its newest chip designs and talk about working with German companies on AI computing power. Germany's leader is also expected to meet Huang to discuss how the two sides can work together.

AI technology is changing many jobs and daily life. From hospitals to factories, more places are using AI to work faster and better. But experts also warn that countries need to think carefully about how to use AI safely.

For students learning English today, AI is not just news — it may become part of their future work.

questions.q: When will Jensen Huang give his speech?

options: Countries need to use AI carefully and safely
